shortDescription: Fail-over BIG-IP Next HA instance on CM

options.name: active_unit_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the BIG-IP Next unit in HA pair to be made active. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(active_unit_ip).

options.name: active_unit_ip
options.description: The ip address of the BIG-IP Next unit in HA pair to be made active. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(active_unit_hostname).

options.name: ha_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the HA BIG-IP Next instance. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(ha_ip).

options.name: ha_ip
options.description: The ip address of the HA BIG-IP Next instance. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(ha_hostname).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time to wait for the HA failover task to finish, in seconds. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
